result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: the Orders tab in the bottom navigation is missing its icon.

issues.description: The 'Orders' item in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon, leaving an empty space above the label while Home, Search, and Profile all display icons. This makes the navigation look broken and inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Restore the Orders icon (e.g., receipt/list icon) at the same size, stroke, and grey inactive color as the other navigation icons, and verify all tab labels remain vertically aligned.
